g.text: Friday 24 July, 09:00. A detective who loses her notebook starts the interview again. LANTERN, after a
compaction, has only what the summary kept.
Case file 02 gave it a memory file, and the file kept its mistakes along with its findings. This is
narrower: working notes for one task, in a form code can read, kept outside the window and opened when
Varma asks the only question she ever asks about a new record. "Who can write in it?"
"The agent. Only for this run. And every line says which statement it came from."
"Then I can check it," she says.
. A notebook that checks what is written in it
{"kept": false, "refused": "a note needs its source: the file the flow was read from"}
{"kept": false, "refused": "corvane-trading.csv shows no payment to Arden Logistics Ltd"}
The third is the mistake LANTERN's own summary made in chapter
: Arden as a payee of Corvane's. The
notebook compares a note with its source's digest before keeping it.
. A compaction in the middle, without notes and with
The same lossy compaction, with and without a notebook

Meridian Trust Bank corvane-trading.csv shows no payment to Sabran Mercantile Bank calder-reach.csv gives

statements the first had read. With the notebook, which

LANTERN now keeps working notes outside the window, and a note is kept only if it names its statement
and agrees with it. Compacted to a paragraph as in chapter 10, the trace reported 1 of 7 hops without
notes and 2 with a notebook read back after each compaction, totals right on 2; the notebook kept 6
flows and refused 4. Stopped after 8 requests and started again, a session with no notes reopened 4
statements and reported 7 hops; a session given the notebook reopened 5 and reported 6, totals right on
